summary: End-to-end testing of Plume Suites iteration 2 (Smoobu booking iframe, SEO via react-helmet-async, redesigned editorial hero, 3 new cycling journal articles, internal /reserver routing). 9/9 backend pytest tests pass, 18/18 frontend flows pass including Smoobu external iframe injection.
critical_code_review_comments: Smoobu iframe loads external 3rd party script (login.smoobu.com/js/Settings/BookingToolIframe.js). Confirmed it injects iframe + 3 child elements into #apartmentIframeAll within ~7s. No CSP issues observed.
JOURNAL_ARTICLES is now ~290 lines inside server.py — consider extracting to /app/backend/journal_data.py to keep server.py under ~150 lines and ease future CMS migration.
GET /api/contact still has no auth — exposes all contact submissions publicly. Same finding as iteration 1; not blocking but should be locked down before production.

react-helmet-async is correctly wired (HelmetProvider in App.js, Seo component on every page). Verified <title> updates per route + JSON-LD Hotel on Home and HotelRoom on SuiteDetail and Article on JournalArticle.
Language switcher data-testid was renamed from lang-fr/lang-en to lang-switch-fr/lang-switch-en between iterations — note for downstream tests.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed contact_messages via pytest POST /api/contact and one extra via Playwright form submission. Non-destructive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py now cover 8-article journal (3 cycling first), bilingual body, contact CRUD + invalid email. Frontend testids of interest: hero-section, hero-cta-book, hero-cta-suites, nav-book-button, footer-book-button, suite-book-douceur, suite-book-envolee (presumed similar), reserver-page, smoobu-booking-iframe (#apartmentIframeAll container), journal-card-{slug} for all 8 articles, contact-name/email/subject/message/submit, mobile-menu-toggle, mobile-menu, lang-switch-fr, lang-switch-en. Smoobu external script populates iframe in ~5-7s — wait 7s before asserting childElementCount > 0. JSON-LD verification: parse all <script type='application/ld+json'> and match by @type (Hotel/HotelRoom/Article).
rca of the issue: No issues. Initial WARN on lang-en testid was a stale selector from iteration 1 spec — actual testids are lang-switch-fr/lang-switch-en. EN switch confirmed working (hero text -> 'Slow down, by the canal.').
